thread:
Sam: Observed duplicate token refreshes + auth server rate-limit when enabling SDK retries + OkHttp default retries on emulator (API 33).
Hannah: Can you share logs or a minimal repro?
Sam: Minimal setup: kotlin-sdk config enables sdk-level retries (maxAttempts=3), still using OkHttp default retryOnConnectionFailure=true and our TokenAuthenticator. When a request gets 401 the Authenticator does a refresh, but because of combination of RetryAndFollowUpInterceptor + sdk retry wrapper the same logical call ends up re-entering and triggering multiple concurrent refreshes. Auth server returns 429 eventually.
Sam: Quick log snippet:
```
[12:01:05.123] Request A -> 401
[12:01:05.124] Authenticator: start refresh #1
[12:01:05.130] Retry wrapper: retrying call (attempt=2)
[12:01:05.131] Request A (replay) -> 401
[12:01:05.132] Authenticator: start refresh #2
[12:01:05.200] Auth refresh 1 -> success
[12:01:05.201] Auth refresh 2 -> 429 rate-limited
```
Vik: Yikes. This is a cross-layer interaction: OkHttp will transparently retry or replay the call in some scenarios and our SDK's outer retry logic doesn't know about in-flight auth refresh.
Hannah: Two quick mitigations: (1) coalesce refreshes (single-flight) in TokenAuthenticator so concurrent callers await the same refresh; (2) make SDK retrier avoid retrying on auth paths (if call sees 401 start of refresh, don't re-enqueue).
Vik: Also consider setting OkHttpClient.Builder.retryOnConnectionFailure(false) in sampleapp when SDK-managed retries are enabled. That prevents unexpected replays by OkHttp. But document trade-offs.
Sam: For sampleapp change I tried a minimal single-flight using AtomicReference<CompletableDeferred<String>?>(null) so only the first refresh does network and others await it. It fixed the 429s in my repro. Snippet:
```
private val currentRefresh = AtomicReference<CompletableDeferred<String>?>(null)
fun refreshToken(): String = runBlocking {
  val existing = currentRefresh.get() ?: CompletableDeferred<String>().also { d ->
    if (currentRefresh.compareAndSet(null, d)) {
      try { d.complete(doNetworkRefresh()) } finally { currentRefresh.set(null) }
    }
  }
  currentRefresh.get()!!.await()
}
```
Hannah: Nice. We should still avoid blocking on Main though; make sure the refresh uses Dispatchers.IO.
Vik: Longer-term: update docs with a section "Retries & auth: cross-layer hazards" explaining OkHttp replay behavior, SDK-level retry semantics, and pattern recommendations: single-flight refresh, sync fast-path cache, or disable OkHttp replay when using SDK retries.
CI-Bot: CI: flaky integration test https://ci/internal/29012 observed on emulator api-33, reproducer attached to PR.
Sam: I'll open PR that: adds single-flight helper to sampleapp TokenAuthenticator, sets retryOnConnectionFailure=false in the sampleapp OkHttpClient if sdk.retries.enabled, and adds docs blurb. PR #1422 opened.
Hannah: Also add a small unit that simulates RetryAndFollowUpInterceptor replay + concurrent refresh to guard against regressions.
Sam: Good call. I'll add that test and attach repro steps in PR. :thumbsup:
